data.name: DmanUsage
data.value: usage: dman [-vb] NAME | dman --download (NAME is a C# or VB keyword, a .NET namespace, type or member like String.Split, or a learn.microsoft.com address)

data.name: DmanNotFound
data.value: dman: no .NET or language page for '{0}'

data.name: DmanDownloadingIndex
data.value: dman: downloading the {0} name index, only needed once...

data.name: DmanDownloadBusy
data.value: dman: another shell is already downloading the docs.

data.name: DmanDownloadingApi
data.value: dman: downloading the .NET API docs from GitHub, one archive of about 140 MB that unpacks to about 600 MB...

data.name: DmanDownloadingKeywords
data.value: dman: downloading the C# and Visual Basic keyword pages...

data.name: DmanDownloadDone
data.value: dman: saved {0} API files and {1} keyword pages in {2}. dman downloads them again in the background once they're a week old.
